name: TimeForge
oneLiner: Restaurant and retail labor management software for scheduling, time and attendance and labor compliance, with Lineup.ai's AI sales and labor forecasting built in since 2024.
bestFor: Restaurant groups and franchise operators (quick service and casual dining) that want sales-driven schedules, time tracking and labor compliance in one system, using AI forecasts from their POS data.

customers.name: Great Harvest Bread Co. (Great Harvest Franchising, preferred vendor)

updates.text: Joined Square's app ecosystem with an integration that pulls Square POS sales into TimeForge to forecast labor and set staffing levels.

features: AI sales and labor forecasting from POS history (Lineup.ai technology), in 15-minute increments
Sales-driven, auto-generated employee schedules matched to forecast demand
Time and attendance with clock-in tracking and real-time alerts when labor runs over target
Labor law compliance support, including overtime rules and predictive (fair workweek) scheduling
Employee self-service for availability, shift swaps and time off
Multi-unit reporting on labor cost against sales
POS integrations including Toast, Square and others

pricing.text: Custom pricing; contact TimeForge for a quote. Older vendor blog posts and third-party directories show conflicting figures, so none are quoted.

notes: Replaces the Lineup.ai review: TimeForge (Lubbock, TX; founded 1998) added Lineup.ai to its platform in August 2024 (https://timeforge.com/?p=30903, https://hospitalitytech.com/timeforge-adds-lineupai-its-platform-ai-powered-forecasting-labor-solutions); Lineup.ai's forecasting now sits inside TimeForge. A TimeForge blog post names Jamba, Blue Ribbon Restaurants and Original Joe's with 25-40% scheduling-time reductions, but it reads as marketing content, so they were left out. Vendor claims such as 'up to 95% forecast accuracy' are unverified and left out. A Heartland Restaurant POS integration is mentioned by a directory listing but no dated announcement was found, so it was left out. Pricing: a TimeForge blog post cites $1.50/$2.00 per employee per month and an AWG reseller page cites $295/month per location (grocery); both may be dated and don't match third-party listings, so they're not quoted.
